title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week's spotlight is Simon & Garfunkel's "El Condor Pasa (If I Could)" — a slender, high-altitude folk song that floats rather than pushes. From their 1970 album Bridge over Troubled Water, it lifts the Quechua-andina melody "El Cóndor Pasa" into a gentle, airy meditation on longing: "I'd rather be a sparrow than a snail... I'd rather feel the earth beneath my feet." In a Djembe set it lands as a soft, breathy centerpiece that lets the room exhale — a wisp of wind after the noise.
songListNote: Song of the Week — Simon & Garfunkel's airy folk classic "El Condor Pasa (If I Could)" joins the request catalog this week.
